messages:
Sofia Martinez: quick flag on PaperTrail onboarding. p95 up ~30ms and tokens +19% last week. AM put renewal on watch. propose quick proactive play: AWQ pilot on low-risk intents + compact-model swap for summary path + intent-based routing to dedicated during peak. thoughts?
Liam O'Connor: agree. split intents: payments/auth = no change, receipts/faq/summaries = candidates. recommend 24h micro-canary first, capture cosine similarity and user error rate.
Rhea Banerjee: add warmup plan  cold KV usually spikes p95 when model changes. pre-warm dedicated nodes 15m prior, run synthetic ramp for 10m, enable prefix-KV caching for top 40 prefixes.
Sofia Martinez: rollback criteria suggestion: answer_similarity_drop>0.025 OR user_error_rate+0.004 OR p95_increase>0.10 -> rollback. I'll draft customer note with conservative savings (6-9%) and propose 30-day checkpoint before renewal.
DevOps-bot: reminder set: PaperTrail_canary_check at 2976628800. page on rollback criteria.
Liam O'Connor: I'll own the canary and eval set, include 40 human eval items for perceived quality.
Rhea Banerjee: I'll wire warmup hooks and routing policy in staging, add alert if p95 > baseline + 20ms.
Sofia Martinez: assigning: @Liam run canary + human eval, @Rhea warmup + routing, @Sofia customer note + CS board update. update by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
